ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Hostile Flora
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
HOSTILE_MOBILE_PLANTS_1 / REACTION_MECHANISM_GENERALISE_1 step 2 — owner ruling 2026-09-22, verbatim: "yes we should ALSO make some 'animals' that are hostile mobile plants too, that's cool." His quotation marks around "animals" are the design note: these are real ThingDef+race+PawnKindDef animal defs with real AI, never Plant defs — a RimWorld Plant cannot move or fight.
RM tier per the item's own tiering ruling (Q11a): an INVENTED exotic name (gallowroot) is not Star Wars IP and lives here, franchise-free. Behaviour is NOT duplicated here — every reaction (waking hostile, waking same-kind neighbours) is the shared mandrake.rm.creaturebehaviors mechanism (RM_CompReactionSource + RM_ReactionPropagationRule_SameKindWithinRadius + RM_ReactionResponseRule_ActivateSelf); this mod supplies only the species def itself.
⚠️ THIS IS A MINIMAL WAVE, NOT THE FULL BUILD HOSTILE_MOBILE_PLANTS_1 OWES. It exists to host REACTION_MECHANISM_GENERALISE_1 step 2 (same-kind-within- radius propagation spending a SHARED budget) as a real second consumer of the mechanism the wasps proved, not to answer that item's five still-open design questions. Specifically NOT done here, and still owed to HOSTILE_MOBILE_PLANTS_1 proper: - The design sitting on those five questions (which biome(s), how many/how different, what makes it read as a plant rather than an animal, how dangerous to whom, huntable/harvestable) — item explicitly says "author nothing before that" for the ROSTER; this is one signature creature built to prove the mechanism, not a roster. - The "rooted and still, with an occasional leaf-twitch" idle read and its UNDECIDED animation route — this def uses a plain animal MoveSpeed and ordinary wander/idle AI. It does not yet read as a plant standing still; that is real remaining work, flagged UNDECIDED in the item on purpose. - A proximity trigger ("hostile to anything that comes close"). The shared reaction mechanism's only trigger surfaces are damage (PostPostApplyDamage) and an explicit TriggerReaction() call — there is no "something walked within N cells" trigger yet. This def only reacts when hurt (or when propagated into by a neighbour that was hurt); a colonist can currently walk right up to an undisturbed one. - Real art. bodyGraphicData below reuses the vanilla Tortoise sheet (tinted), the same placeholder-reuse move RM_Gelatid already makes in mandrake.rm.gelatinousslime — checked infrastructure/artpipe this pass, no gallowroot job exists yet, queued or done. - Biome roster placement. Not wired into any BiomeDef's wildAnimals — placement is the owning biome's own review sitting per BIOME_SPECIFIC_FAUNA_LAW_1, never a sweep, and no biome has been chosen.
Mod Settings: reuses mandrake.rm.creaturebehaviors' existing reactionSourceSpawnEnabled / reactionSourceBudgetMultiplier — the shared event budget IS the one number the mechanism's own spec calls load-bearing, and it is already a toggle+dial there. No new setting is owed for this mod alone.
